Hello Jobseekers in Dubai (UAE) #Hybrid

Glad  to share another opportunity that we are currently supporting through Vinicio Adivisory.

We are looking for a Business Analyst who can bridge business requirements and technology solutions, work closely with stakeholders, analyze processes, and contribute to projects that drive measurable business outcomes.

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy problem-solving, requirements gathering, process improvement, data-driven decision-making, and working with cross-functional teams.
A great opportunity to be part of an organization focused on growth, transformation, and innovation.

We Are Hiring – Senior Power BI Developer | UAE
📍 Location: United Arab Emirates
We are looking for an experienced Senior Power BI Developer to join our team in the UAE.
🔹 Key Requirements:
- Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience.
- Strong expertise in Power BI development.
- Excellent knowledge of data visualization.
- Experience in dashboard development.
- Strong knowledge of data modelling and reporting.
⚠️ Important Eligibility Criteria:
- Must currently reside in the UAE.
- Candidates based outside the UAE are NOT eligible.
- Only UAE-based candidates will be considered.
📩 How to Apply:
Send your updated CV to:
https://lnkd.in/dNxn3AtA
📌 Suggested Email Subject: Senior Power BI Developer – UAE
🚫 Do NOT send CVs via LinkedIn DM.
✅ Click on the job link.
✅ Click Apply Now on the website.
📧 Find the official HR email and send your CV directly.
👉 For fast job updates, join our WhatsApp channel here:
https://lnkd.in/dGnX7Ggc
Please share this opportunity with suitable candidates in your network!
